propositions: Plan-review gate currently lacks a criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, causing FixedBench over-action gap where plans add mechanisms without establishing necessity.
Bug tickets bypass substantive plan review entirely, short-circuiting to bare exempt-PASS with no DET floor or LLM analysis.
A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate need or reproduction, accepting well-motivated and docs-only outcomes.
Bugs must run a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe) instead of full gate bypass, never blocking the bug.
Both advisory criteria must auto-flow into the standing recorder for effectiveness monitoring without explicit wiring.
Advisory-to-blocking promotion is gated on trailing effectiveness metrics (high detection, low false-positive rate, sufficient sample).
